thread:
Alex W: Heads up — after the squashfs-based packaging change I’m seeing traces with function names but no line numbers in perfetto/nsys. Noticed when investigating a latency spike from KV-cache path. Anyone run into this?
Maria K: yep. squashfs + overlay can drop separate .debug files if we weren’t embedding them. quick check: do you have a .gnu_debuglink or external debuginfo package? :thinking_face:
Alex W: Our container build mounts /usr/lib/debug into the image at build time, then squashes. I can see binaries under /opt/runtime/bin but no /usr/lib/debug inside final squash.
Samir P: that’ll do it. Line info comes from .debug sections (or separate .debug files). If those are missing traces show symbols only or just addresses. nsys sometimes falls back to symbol servers but perfetto needs paths or packaged debuginfo.
Jin L: also check if the build used -g and whether strip was run with --strip-debug vs using objcopy. I’ve seen CI run `strip --strip-all` accidentally.
Alex W: build flags: we compile with -g -O2 and use path remapping: -fdebug-prefix-map=/repo=/. But CI step runs `eu-strip --strip-debug` on the binary later.
Maria K: that’s the culprit — --strip-debug can remove the debug sections from the binary itself. If you have a .gnu_debuglink pointing to an external file, ensure that file survives into the runtime image.
Samir P: quick repro commands that helped me before:
```
readelf -n /opt/runtime/bin/serve | grep GNU
# or
eu-readelf -n /opt/runtime/bin/serve | sed -n '1,10p'
```
You should see a GNU_BUILD_ID. Then check for the debuglink: `objdump --private-headers serve | grep .gnu_debuglink`
Maria K: also check cupti/driver mismatch — nsys resolves a lot using host cupti libs. If the container has a different libcupti.so than the host nsys expects you can get partial symbol resolution. Run: `ls -l /usr/local/cuda/extras/CUPTI/lib64` inside container.
Alex W: interesting — inside squashfs the libcupti.so is from CUDA 12.2 but our host has CUDA 12.0. ops-bot shows recent node images upgraded to 12.2 last week.
Jin L: nsys has a probe that tries to use CUPTI to map GPU symbols. If the agent and CUPTI runtime disagree you can get truncated stacks or missing line info for GPU kernels. For CPU-side missing line numbers it’s still the debug info issue though.
Samir P: two actionables: 1) verify that either the binary retains .debug info or the separate .debug file is copied into the final squashfs under the same path as on build host (or use debuglink with the file present). 2) run nsys with explicit symbol paths: `nsys profile --symbol-paths=/opt/debug:/usr/lib/debug -o trace` and perfetto with `--symbolizer-binary` path if using local symbolizer.
Alex W: tried the symbol-paths trick, nsys now shows line numbers for CPU frames but perfetto UI still shows blanks for a few timeline entries (GPU kernels).
Maria K: GPU part could be CUPTI + stripped cubin. Check the embedded cubin sections: `objdump -s -j .nv.info libmylib.so | head` and ensure cubin has debug info or nvdisasm mapping available. Also confirm `LD_LIBRARY_PATH` inside trace agent matches libcupti.so with same SONAME.
Alex W: ran `objdump` — cubin section present but looks like it was built with `-lineinfo` off (we historically toggled it for size).
Samir P: that explains it. Lineinfo for device code is separate. If you need GPU kernel line numbers, rebuild with -lineinfo for nvcc/clang device flags. Otherwise traces will only show kernel names or addresses.
Jin L: we should also add an internal QA check: fail CI if final image is missing /usr/lib/debug or if the build-id referenced by the binary has no matching .debug file in the artifacts store. Quick script: `eu-readelf -n bin | awk '/Build ID/ {print $3}' | xargs -I{} test -f /debugstore/{}.debug || echo missing {}`.
Alex W: good idea. For now I’ll push a fix to our squashfs pipeline to include debug files and pin CUPTI to 12.0 in the agent image. Will try full repro after. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
perf-bot: Automated nsys check: found 3 traces referencing build-id 7f3a9c2b that have no matching debug file in debugstore. See /infra/trace-audits/1974506789 for details.
ops-bot: Note: nodes in prod pool were updated to CUDA 12.2 on 2026-02-14 03:12 UTC (image: gpu-2026-02-14). Rolling back to 12.0 will affect other teams.
Maria K: FYI — if rollback is heavy, we can instead bundle the host-compatible libcupti.so into the agent (static copy) and set LD_PRELOAD for the profiler process. Not ideal but fast.
Alex W: will try the copy + LD_PRELOAD approach first, and follow up with the debugfile restore. Posting updates in this thread.
Samir P: LGTM, ping me if you want me to run a perfetto trace on the staging cluster after the fix.
